headline: Senior Azure DevOps & Platform Engineer | Kubernetes | GitOps
page_title: Rajendra P N - Senior Azure DevOps & Platform Engineer
summary_html: Senior Azure DevOps & Platform Engineer with 10+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, SaaS delivery, and production operations. Builds secure, highly available Azure platforms with Terraform/Bicep, AKS, Docker, Helm, and Argo CD GitOps. Automates CI/CD and operational tooling with Python, Bash, and PowerShell; improves reliability through observability, incident response, capacity planning, and cost optimization. Combines Azure and AWS platform experience with microservices delivery, identity controls, relational database operations, and cross-team engineering mentorship.
